I have one hectare of wheat here in Oromia, and wheat needs fertilizer to give a proper harvest. I will go to the cooperative for DAP and urea like last year, though I worry the urea may come late again. I cannot afford improved seed for the whole plot this season, so I will plant the seed I saved from last harvest. My husband and older children will help with weeding and harvest, but I will need to hire a few people for the harvest days because wheat must be cut quickly.
